title: The discovery of gas-rich, dusty starbursts in luminous reddened quasars at z ∼ 2.5 with ALMA
question: Are dusty, massive reddened quasars at z~2.5 gas-rich, starbursting hosts, representing an evolutionary link between SMGs and unobscured quasars?

data.sensitivity: continuum RMS 11-20 uJy/beam; channel RMS 0.11-0.21 mJy/beam

what.value: CO(3-2) detections and FIR/dust properties of ULASJ1539+0557 and ULASJ1002+0137
CO and IR luminosity compilations of high-z galaxies and quasars

evidence.quote: the compilations of CO detections in high redshift galaxies and quasars published by (cite: Carilli:13) and (cite: Heywood:13)
assuming a gas-to-dust ratio of 91$\pm^{60}_{36}$ from observations of nearby galaxies (cite: Sandstrom:13)

recipe.goal: Image continuum and CO line cubes
recipe.method: Pipeline calibration, MFS continuum clean (natural), uvcontsub, line cube clean, primary beam correction

recipe.goal: Dust masses, FIR luminosity and SFR from 3 mm continuum
recipe.method: Optically thin Rayleigh-Jeans dust mass from single photometric point; greybodies scaled to ALMA flux for L_FIR (40-300 um); Kennicutt relation for SFR

recipe.goal: Gas masses from CO and dust
recipe.method: CO(3-2) to CO(1-0) with r32/10=0.8, alpha_CO=0.8; dust-based gas mass with gas-to-dust 91; derived alpha_CO

recipe.goal: Line fits, spectroastrometry and dynamical masses
recipe.method: Single/double Gaussian fits and moments; red/blue spectroastrometric offset; Gnerucci, virial and Neri estimators
assumptions: R=4 kpc for sources not resolved

recipe.method: rotcur in iterative mode on single-Gaussian velocity field, PA fixed, 1-15 rings
2-D Gaussian fits to collapsed CO maps; checked with Briggs robust=0.5 and uvmodelfit
Compare 850um fluxes, LCO-LIR, FWHM-LCO with SMGs, quasars, HotDOGs; KS tests

evidence.quote: The dust masses range from 2.5$\times$10$^{8}$M$_\odot$ to 1.2$\times$10$^9$M$_\odot$.
the gas depletion timescales are very short - $\sim5-20$ Myr
We measure a (1.20$\pm$0.13) arcsec offset between the two maps
The best fit tilted ring model has $i$=57$\pm$8$^{\circ}$.
The maximum rotational velocity, $v_{\rm{max}}$=125$\pm$6 km s$^{-1}$ at r=21.5 kpc.

not_stated_but_needed: tclean/clean parameters: cell size, image size, masks, cleaning threshold, niter
which channels were treated as line-free per source
how Herschel SPIRE/PACS photometry was taken (from Banerji et al. 2014)
pixel-level moment fitting details and ring widths/initial guesses for rotcur
how the 15 rotcur rings were set up and the uncertainty criteria
source radius R=4 kpc assumption for non-resolved sources justification
missing_for_reproduction: clean parameters (cell, image size, masks, thresholds)
score_reason: Public data and simple analysis with explicit equations and assumptions, but imaging parameters and some fitting details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, recipe is largely complete, and results (fluxes, line intensities, masses) are numeric.
